data.long_meaning: The name Susant is a Sanskrit and Hindu name that means 'auspicious', 'graceful', 'prosperous'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'su' which means 'good' and 'sant' which means 'present' or 'established'. Susant is a name that signifies the presence of good fortune and prosperity in one's life. The name Susant carries the meaning “Graceful, Auspicious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Susant usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, auspicious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Susant is believed to have spiritual significance in Hinduism. It is associated with the Hindu deity Lord Subrahmanya, also known as Kartikeya. Susant is believed to bring the blessings of Lord Subrahmanya, who is the god of war, knowledge, and medicine. He is also known as the god of youth, strength, and virility. Susant is a name that is believed to bring grace, calmness, and peace to one's life, and to bestow the blessings of good health, knowledge, and strength.
